name: M4.ripple
title: Rotor ripple map
summary: Cogging and commutation ripple as rotor-periodic torque harmonics at the output (the torque_ripple records in one map), optionally with Coulomb and viscous friction.
equation: tau_r = sum_k amplitude_k*sin(rotor_harmonic_k*theta_rotor + phase_k), theta_rotor = gear_ratio*theta_output in rad from the rotor zero the simulator uses (tau_r adds coulomb_friction*sign(v) + viscous_friction*v when stated)

theta_rotor.definition: The rotor's angle, gear_ratio times the output angle from the rotor zero the simulator uses.

output.name: tau_r
output.definition: The resisting torque at the output: what the motor must add to move the output as the inputs say.
output.sign: The joint feels -tau_r (a resisting torque opposes motion; ripple pushes and pulls with angle).

harmonics.definition: The ripple harmonics: a list of {rotor_harmonic, amplitude, phase}, rotor_harmonic in cycles per rotor turn (an integer >= 1, each once), amplitude in the term's unit (>= 0, the torque at the output), phase in rad.
harmonics.measured_by: a rotor-angle sweep (the plateaus, if they cover more than one rotor turn)

coulomb_friction.measured_by: velocity plateaus, both directions, 6-8 speeds, each at least one rotor turn

viscous_friction.measured_by: velocity plateaus, both directions, 6-8 speeds, each at least one rotor turn

python.note: The contract's own ruler: stdlib Python, torque(terms, inputs, state, dt) -> (tau_r, state), terms in SI.

js.note: The same equation as model.py as an ES module (torque(terms, inputs, state, dt) -> {tau, state}); tests/acceptance_v2/test_amendment_2_5.py holds the two to 1e-12.

friction_solref.definition: The joint's solreffriction (timeconst, dampratio): how hard frictionloss sticks; MuJoCo's soft default creeps below about 0.4 rad/s on a light hinge.

friction_solimp.definition: The joint's solimpfriction (dmin, dmax, width, midpoint, power), every entry > 0.

mujoco.note: Friction natively; the plugin applies the ripple from the rotor angle each step.

output_speed.definition: |v|, the output speed the terms were fitted or checked across.

assumptions: The ripple is periodic in the rotor angle and the same in both directions (cogging); direction-dependent ripple is not modelled.
The harmonics hold wherever the joint goes, because the magnets turn with the rotor.
